purpose: Read-only audited exact stale clone cleanup candidates. No deletions performed.
limits: Only exact listed raw log files and exact four cache directories are candidates.
Do not remove clone root, Docs/Verification root, or Library root.
All gzip counterparts must remain. Raw bytes were compared against decompressed gzip SHA-256, and gzip bytes matched committed Git blob.
Allocated sizes are not guaranteed physical reclamation on APFS shared extents.
Root must preserve and push current new work before guarded deletion.
